ED, Bengaluru has secured conviction under the PMLA, 2002 against retired Excise Guard M. Ramachandra and his daughter R. Yurekha, with the Special Court in Bengaluru pronouncing the order on 14 October 2026 in the matter of possessing inproportionate assets.

ED, Lucknow has filed a Prosecution Complaint before the Special PMLA Court, Ghaziabad, against M/s FIITJEE Ltd and its directors, Dinesh Kumar Goel and Monila Goel, for money laundering involving students fees misappropriation, seeking their conviction and the confiscation of Rs. 71.88 crore of attached seized assets.

ED has seized assets worth ₹2,032.81 crores belonging to Reliance Power Ltd under Section 37A of FEMA, including bank balances and its shareholding in Sasan Power Limited, equivalent in value to foreign exchange held abroad in alleged contravention of Section 4 in connection with fabricated write off of overseas investments and advances made to companies in British Virgin Islands (BVI) and the Cayman Islands.

ED, Bangalore has filed a Prosecution Complaint before the Hon’ble Special Court (PMLA), Bangalore, on 07.10.2026 against 03 accused persons/entities involving M/s Jaa Lifestyle India Pvt. Ltd. & its directors in connection with running fraudulent membership based model for enrolling members and collection funds from the public in the name of earning through company's digital marketing and advertisement viewing programme.

ED, Bangalore has filed Supplementary Prosecution Complaint before the Hon’ble Special Court (PMLA), Bangalore, on 05.10.2026 against 05 accused persons involving Ayub Sayyed & others in a matter related to siphoning off of funds pertaining to Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Development Corporation Ltd. by using forged documents and impersonation.

title: ED, Mumbai has filed a Prosecution Complaint under the PMLA, 2002 before the Special Court in Mumbai against Bernadette Bharat Varma, her husband, and 9 others in connection with the fraudulent siphoning of funds of Rs.79 Cr. Pertaining to United Services Club.

ED, Mumbai has filed a Prosecution Complaint (PC) against Hitesh Mehta and 7 others under the provisions of PMLA, 2002 before the Hon'ble Special Court (PMLA), Mumbai in a matter related to embezzlement of bank funds of New India Co-operative Bank Limited (NICBL). The Hon’ble PMLA Special Court has ordered for issuance of pre-cognizance notices to accused in the matter.

Directorate of Enforcement (ED), Bhubaneswar Zonal Office has conducted search operation at 12 premises located at Odisha and West Bengal on 09.10.2026 and 12.10.2026, in connection with leakage of question paper of Sub Inspector Recruitment Exam-2024 in Odisha. Investigation and searches conducted so far has unearthed the role of companies/ entities which have so far remained outside the investigative net of agencies. Further, searches have also revealed the possible role of other persons including those associated with OPRB & other companies/ entities. During search, various incriminating documents/devices/records were found and seized, as per the provisions of PMLA, 2002.

ED, has provisionally attached movable and immovable properties worth Rs. 136.42 Crore belonging to M/s Ocean Seven Buildtech Pvt Ltd (OSBPL), promoter Swaraj Singh Yadav, and his wife, under the PMLA, 2002 in connection with the cheating, forgery, and criminal conspiracy in real estate projects. This brings total attached assets in the case to Rs. 188 Crore for OSBPL.

ED, Hyderabad successfully registered 7 auctioned properties worth ₹15.03 Crore including 6 flats in Shaikpet and a house in Banjara Hills in favor of successful H-1 bidders under the PMLA,2002 in connection with Heera Group Ponzi case, where Nowhera Shaik and associates duped investors of over ₹5,978 Crore with false promises of 36% annual returns.

ED, Hyderabad, has provisionally attached immovable and movable assets worth Rs. 129.85 Cr belonging to M/s Bhole Baba Oroganic Dairymilk Pvt. Ltd., M/s Sri Vyshnavi Dairy Specialities Pvt. Ltd., their promoters viz Vipin Jain & Pomil Jain, and their family members; M/s Sukriti Foods Pvt. Ltd., its promoter Kailash Chand Mangla and his family members; and other related entities/individuals, under PMLA, 2002, as part of an ongoing money laundering probe into the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD) ghee adulteration fraud.
party_names: Bhole Baba Oroganic Dairymilk Pvt. Ltd.
Sri Vyshnavi Dairy Specialities Pvt. Ltd.

title: ED, Jaipur has filed a Prosecution Complaint on 07.10.2026 before the Hon'ble Special Court (PMLA), Jaipur, under PMLA, 2002 against Subhash Chandra Bijnoriya alias Subhash Chandra Bijarnia and other accused persons/entities, in the case of Nexa Evergreen investment fraud involving PoC of Rs. 932.54 Crore.

ED, Chandigarh has arrested Harcharan Singh Bhullar, the then Deputy Inspector General (DIG), Ropar Range, Punjab Police, on 09.10.2026, under Section 19 of PMLA, 2002, in connection with a money laundering investigation related to corruption & disproportionate assets. The Hon'ble Special Court (PMLA), Chandigarh, has granted 08 days ED custody of Harcharan Singh Bhullar.

In a significant step towards investor restitution, the Hon’ble Special PMLA Court, Mumbai, has permitted monetisation of assets attached by ED worth ₹3,464 Crore (approx.) towards a ₹1,950 Crore settlement for 5,682 specified creditors under the NCLT-approved Scheme in National Spot Exchange Limited (NSEL) case. ED remains committed to securing Proceeds of Crime and facilitating restitution to eligible investors in accordance with law.

ED, Raipur has arrested Ram Gopal Agarwal on 09.10.2026 under Section 19 of the PMLA, 2002, in connection with the Chhattisgarh Custom Rice Milling Scam involving an illegal collection of Rs. 147 Cr. (approx.) from rice millers, following which the Hon'ble Special Court (PMLA), Raipur, has granted 5 days of ED custody.

ED, Raipur has filed a supplementary prosecution complaint under the PMLA, 2002 against Ramgopal Agrawal, former treasurer of the Chhattisgarh PCC, in the liquor scam case, following the provisional attachment of two Raipur properties worth Rs 9.06 Crore on October 8, 2026. Agrawal, who was arrested by the ED on August 11, 2026, remains in judicial custody.

ED, Delhi has provisionally attached immovable assets worth Rs. 140 Crore (approx.) belonging to M/s Earth Infrastructure Ltd, its promoters Avdhesh Kumar Goel, Rajnish Mittal, Atul Gupta, Vikas Gupta, their families, and related entities under the PMLA, 2002, as part of an ongoing money laundering probe into large-scale public fund fraud and misappropriation.

ED Delhi has provisionally attached two immovable properties worth ₹34.07 Lakh under Section 5(1) of the PMLA, 2002 in connection with a money laundering probe against Kusum and her associates under the NDPS Act. The attached assets a residential flat in Rohini, Delhi, owned by Kusum, and agricultural land in Aligarh, UP, owned by her brother Hariom Raghav, mark a key move by the agency to dismantle the financial backbones of drug syndicates. With a Prosecution Complaint filed on March 30, 2026, an earlier attachment of 12 properties worth ₹2.27 Crore, total attached assets in the case now stand at ₹2.61 crore.

ED, filed Writ Petition No. 33845/2026 before the Telangana High Court on 23.09.2026, seeking a speedy, day-to-day trial and the personal appearance of all accused in the PMLA, 2002 Prosecution Complaints against Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy and 73 others in connection with allegations of large-scale corporate favors and massive quid pro quo investments into his family's companies, extended by the AP Govt during his late father Y.S. Rajasekhar Reddy's tenure as CM.

ED, Lucknow has provisionally attached an immovable property worth Rs. 54.71 Crore in Maharani Bagh, New Delhi, registered under M/s Surbhaee Advertising Pvt. Ltd., under the PMLA, 2002, in connection with the Amrapali Group money laundering case.

ED, Mangalore has filed a Prosecution Complaint against kingpin Shivanand Siddappa Neelannavar and 5 others over a massive Rs. 2,459 Crore Ponzi scam, revealing that Proceeds of Crime were laundered through high-risk stock trading, cooperative society fixed deposits, real estate investments, family bank accounts, and even financing the Kannada film "Champion."

ED, Kolkata has conducted search operations under PMLA, 2002 on 05.10.2026 at 9 premises across the state of West Bengal and Odisha linked to M/s Gupta Power Infrastructure Limited (GPIL), its associated entities and persons connected with its management, in relation to an investigation into bank fraud committed by GPIL. During search, various incriminating documents/devices/records were found and seized. A total of 139 bank accounts related to GPIL, and a number of Mutual Funds and Shares held in the name of GPIL and its associated individuals have been freezed under the provisions of PMLA, 2002. Further, 3 high end cars (2 Mercedes and 1 BMW) have also been freezed u/s 17(1-A) of PMLA, 2002.

ED, Mumbai has arrested Pravin alias Nagesh Ramchandra Shinde and Brijesh Kanjibhai Moradiya under Section 19 of PMLA, 2002 in connection with a money laundering investigation linked to the trans-national organized narcotics syndicate operated by Salim Ismail Dola & associates.

ED, Jaipur has provisionally attached movable and immovable properties worth Rs. 34.91 Crore under the PMLA, 2002, on 06.10.2026, as part of an ongoing money laundering investigation into the Nexa Evergreen fraud case.

ED has provisionally attached 48 immovable properties in Pune, Mumbai, and Raigad worth ₹5,67.45 Cr. held by Prateek Kumar, his son, and controlled entities M/s. Beaming Infradevelopers Pvt. Ltd., M/s. Ganraj Properties Pvt. Ltd. and M/s. Greenfield Estates Limited under the PMLA,2002 in the massive M/s PACL financial fraud case, bringing total attachments to over ₹30,235 Crore.

ED, Bengaluru has arrested Shivashankarappa Sahukar, the suspended KPSC Chairman and B V Geetha, KPSC Member while investigating the multi crore cash for selection racket and Proceeds of Crime tied to the KPSC Veterinary Officers’ Recruitment Examination (for 400 posts), acting on FIRs filed at Vidhana Soudha PS under BNS 2023, as custodial interrogations expose deep rooted malpractices, paper leaks, and systemic corruption in KPSC.

ED, Patna has provisionally attached immovable properties worth Rs. 1.09 Cr. (Approx.) under the PMLA, 2002 belonging to M/s Arena Food and Agro Industries Pvt. Ltd. (Sheikhpura, Bihar) and its associated individuals, including directors and family members.
party_names: Arena Food and Agro Industries Pvt. Ltd.

title: ED, Patna has filed Prosecution Complaint under the PMLA, 2002 before the Special Court, Patna, seeking the conviction of six individuals (Md. Zafar Eqbal, Nitesh Kumar Singh, Santosh Anand, Rajesh Kumar, Manjay Kumar Singh, and Kundan Kumar) for siphoning Rs. 1.29 Crore from PNB Muzaffarpur savings accounts into mule accounts and routing them via hawala. ED has previously frozen Rs. 83 Lakhs in Proceeds of Crime.

ED Patna Zonal Office has filed a Prosecution Complaint under the PMLA, 2002 against Priti Singh, former Field Officer, SBI Manpur Branch, Gaya, for generating Rs. 7.96 Cr. in Proceeds of Crime through fraudulent overdraft facilities and bank record manipulation, which she utilized for personal and family use before subsequent repayment.

ED, Kochi has conducted searches on 17 premises across 3 cooperative banks fraud cases (Urban Co-Operative Society, Angamaly, Thennela Service Co-operative Society & Kuttanellur Co-op Bank), involving Proceeds of Crime worth ₹550/- Crores (approx.). The searches covered multiple cases, aiming to accelerate asset recovery and restitution for thousands of victimized members under the PMLA, 2002.

ED, Kochi has conducted searches on 17 premises across 3 cooperative banks fraud cases (Urban Co-Operative Society, Angamaly, Thennela Service Co-operative Society & Kuttanellur Co-op Bank), involving Proceeds of Crime worth ₹550/- Crores (approx.). The searches covered multiple cases, aiming to accelerate asset recovery and restitution for thousands of victimized members under the PMLA, 2002.

ED, Aizawl has provisionally attached 10 immovable properties worth Rs. 8.12 Cr. under the PMLA, 2002, alongside freezing Rs. 1.20 Cr. in bank balances, bringing the total Proceeds of Crime secured to Rs. 9.33 Cr. in connection with an organised cross-border smuggling network involving dry areca nuts of Myanmar origin, involvement of Zosangpuii, Thangkhanmunga, Zonsanga and Sangneihvela.

ED, Guwahati has cracked down on cyber fraud by issuing a Provisional Attachment Order under the PMLA, 2002, attaching Rs. 2.12 Cr. (approx.) across 43 bank accounts in Axis Bank, Bank of India, Federal Bank, IndusInd Bank, Punjab National Bank, and State Bank of India linked to a digital arrest scam targeting a Guwahati senior citizen.

ED, Kolkata has conducted searches at 12 locations in Mumbai and Ahmedabad under the PMLA, 2002, targeting bank fraud, money laundering, and the misuse of IBC provisions by Tayal group promoters Pravin and Saurabh Tayal in connivance with Resolution Professionals

ED Lucknow Zone has secured conviction of accused Shahid, Harswaroop and Brij Kishore @ Birju and Deepak Rana for the offence of Money Laundering in a matter related to illicit trafficking of Narcotic Substances. They have been sentences with Rigorous imprisonment 4 years each with fine of Rs. 50,000/- each.

ED, Mumbai has provisionally attached immovable properties worth ₹ 230 Crore (present market value ₹ 336 Crore) under the PMLA,2002 against Jai Corp Limited and others, following an investigation that revealed suppressed fair market values and undervalued acquisitions of an Alibaug land parcel via SPV M/s Neelkanth Township and Constructions Private Limited.

title: ED, Mumbai has arrested Ram U. Ramdhani under the PMLA, 2002, in connection with an ongoing investigation in to online gaming and cyber-fraud scam linked to the All Panel Exchange (APX). The Hon’ble Special Court, Mumbai remanded him to ED custody for 07 days and subsequently send to judicial custody.

ED, Mumbai has filed the 3rd Supplementary Prosecution Complaint before the Special PMLA Court against Mehmood Abdul Samad Bhagad (alias Challenger King) in connection with an organised syndicate that misused stolen identities to open mule bank accounts for routing proceeds of cyber fraud, illegal online gaming, and betting.

ED, Mumbai has conducted search operations at 9 locations across Maharashtra's Yavatmal district under the PMLA, 2002 in the case of officials employees of Babaji Date Mahila Sahakari Bank and its borrowers for around and mis-utilization of depositors money resulting in the seizure of numerous incriminating documents and multiple property deeds.

ED, Mumbai has conducted search operation across eight locations in Maharashtra, West Bengal, Gujarat, and Delhi-NCR under the PMLA, 2002 targeting Dharmendra Kumar Chandradev Singh and others in an alleged bogus CSR donation racket where the mechanism was used as a conduit to convert accounted funds into unaccounted cash, resulting in the seizure of ₹21 Lakh (Approx.) in cash alongside incriminating documents and digital devices, while uncovering that ₹200 Cr. (Approx.) in CSR funds were routed through the illicit network.

Ltd., M/s Jai Karni Tradings Pvt. Ltd., M/s Purvottar Agro Pvt. Ltd., M/s N R Associates, and connected individuals in a major foreign-origin areca nut smuggling and laundering case, leading to the seizure of Rs. 95 Lakh (Approx.) in cash, digital devices, freezing of FD (Rs. 85 Lakh Approx.) & various incriminating documents.

ED, Lucknow has provisionally attached a residential land parcel worth Rs. 53.46 Lakh under the PMLA, 2002, located in Khalilabad, Sant Kabir Nagar, registered in the name of Shamsul Huda Khan for taking salary and pension benefits from state exchequer despite acquiring British citizenship.

ED, Chandigarh has conducted searches at the premises of TDI Group Chairperson Ravinder Taneja in connection with an ongoing PMLA, 2002 probe linked to the 2015 Gurgaon Manesar Land Scam involving transactions with Atul Bansal's ABWIL group. During the search incriminated documents, digital devises and luxury vehicles were found and seized.

ED, has conducted search operations at 14 premises across Chandigarh, Mohali, and Panchkula under PMLA, 2002 as part of a money laundering investigation, targeting the alleged embezzlement of ₹645 Crore of public funds belonging to the Government of Haryana, the Chandigarh Municipal Corporation, and other Government accounts. Through IDFC first bank and AU small finance bank.

The 11th Annual General Meeting of ARIN-AP, hosted by the Directorate of Enforcement under India’s Presidency, concluded in New Delhi with the handing over of the Presidency to Singapore for 2027. Under the theme “Closing the Loop: From Tracing to Return”, practitioners from across the region worked to strengthen cooperation on tracing, confiscation and return of the proceeds of crime.

ED Ranchi has arrested Gyaan Chand Jaiswal @ Babloo Jaiswal and Raaj Jaiswal on 30.09.2026 under Section 19 of the PMLA, 2002, in connection with a GST Input Tax Credit fraud case, following search and seizure operations across Jamshedpur and Kolkata that yielded incriminating documents and digital devices.

ED, Bengaluru has arrested S. Vasudevan, CMD and promoter of M/s Ozone Urbana Infra Developers Pvt. Ltd., under Section 19 of the PMLA, 2002, in connection with defrauding homebuyers an ongoing money laundering investigation.
